physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the sacral plexus, the knot of nerves behind and below the navel where the body has held its power since long before there was a brain to argue with. It is the belly. Lower than thought, older than language, the place an animal moves from when it is not afraid. The spine rises out of it. The breath drops into it. When this centre is awake, a person carries a field around them that other people feel before a word is spoken.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. Force is what happens when the head takes over and stops listening downward. The push runs from the jaw and the shoulders, the spine compresses, the breath gets shallow and high, and the belly goes hard and quiet. The exhaustion at the end of a long stretch of trying is the lower body, sealed off and unheard, finally loud enough to register.

The climb out is also bodily. The shoulders drop. The breath finds the lower lung again. Something in the belly unclenches and the spine stops bracing for impact. From there the movement that arrives is not pushed, it rises. The strength people admire in heroes and animals and old dancers is this. A body that has stopped being driven from the top and remembered it was always being moved from below.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Asparagine. Unlike the letters the body has to take in from outside, Asparagine is one the body makes for itself, quietly, all day, out of what is already moving through it. The chemistry of this card does not need to be imported. It is generated in-house.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the whole instruction of the card written one level lower. The strength was never going to be found out there, in the harder push, in the better technique. The body has been making it the entire time, in the same hidden way it makes the rest of itself, and the work was only ever to stop interrupting the manufacture. Asparagine also carries nitrogen through the nervous system, the small messenger that lets the body talk to itself. A fitting floor for a code about hearing what is rising from below. The power is being made. It is asking to be listened to.
